explication: Metasploit Framework is a security testing platform whose modules probe targets, authenticate or exploit vulnerabilities, and collect or report results. The principal workflow is an operator selecting a module, the module communicating with a target, and findings or credentials being retained or returned. The tree shows exploitation, auxiliary scanning and gathering, credential scanning, and exploit payload collections. Source excerpts support specific HTTP-module and Wowza-scanner interactions; other module internals and console dispatch are not sampled, so those links are intentionally not inferred.
